about.heroSubtitle: AI Adoption Made Practical — Empowering Australian SMEs with AI
about.heroBody: LongCare AU exists to close the gap between AI hype and real business outcomes. We pair experienced human mentors with AI-powered learning tools so that individuals and SMEs in Australia can adopt AI safely, responsibly, and with measurable ROI.
about.missionBody: Make AI accessible for everyone — from individuals upskilling for the next decade of work, to SMEs seeking digital transformation. We combine personalised 1-on-1 mentoring with AI learning tools to deliver outcomes you can measure: hours saved, customers served, revenue earned.
about.founderBio1: With 15+ years in technology, Dr. Long founded LongCare AU and BookedAI to make AI accessible to every Australian professional and SME. His mentoring focuses on practical AI integration — prompt engineering, workflow automation, and responsible deployment — translating cutting-edge research into outcomes that show up in your P&L.
